name: pe-corporate-income-tax
description: Prepare Peru business income tax for tax year 2026 before completing a monthly payment or annual corporate return. Covers domiciled companies, Peru permanent establishments, the General Regime, MYPE Tributario entry and graduated tax, the Special Income Regime screen, accounting-to-tax reconciliation, deductions, loss elections, monthly advances, annual credits and SUNAT filing evidence. Identifies the new agrarian-law conditions without treating every agricultural company as an ordinary MYPE. Use for Peru corporate income tax, renta de tercera categoria, Regimen General, RMT, RER, pagos a cuenta, coeficiente, Formulario 710 and Declara Facil 621. Produces a sourced computation, regime decision, return checklist and proposed payment for human approval; specialist sector returns remain separate.
